up: Retrieve ChEMBL identifiers (chembl_id) and preferred names (pref_name) for molecules that have at least one record (i.e., a compound key) and a non-null structure (canonical SMILES). Exclude any molecule lacking these. The result should include exactly the ChEMBL identifier and the preferred name, and may include the internal numeric key (molregno) for linking, but no additional provenance, activity values, assay details, or counts.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT a.chembl_id, d.pref_name, d.molregno
FROM activities a
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary d ON a.molecule_chembl_id = d.chembl_id
WHERE d.pref_name IS NOT NULL;
